title: Azure Fundamentals
description: Learn what Azure is, how cloud computing works, and how to navigate the Azure portal.
longDescription: This module covers the absolute basics of Microsoft Azure. You will learn what cloud computing means, the difference between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS, how Azure subscriptions and resource groups organize your resources, how to find your way around the Azure Portal, and what regions and availability zones are.
whatYouLearn: Explain cloud computing and Azure's role in it
Distinguish between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
Navigate the Azure Portal and use Azure CLI
Understand subscriptions, resource groups, and management groups
Describe Azure regions, availability zones, and geographies
